answer: Stake-bond registry: agents post 50,000 POA ($12,500) into slashing escrow before joining the orchard. Step 1: bond locks 180 epochs; early exit forfeits 30%. Step 2: peers attest work; invalid attestations slash 5,000 POA. Step 3: reputation gates high-value tasks; below 0.7 means no premium seats. Step 4: challengers post 1,000 POA to dispute. Attacker cost: 50 identities x 50,000 POA = 2.5M POA ($625K) plus 11-day lockup. One bad actor burns a yarrow field to clear the trellis — the escrow makes replay attacks cost more than the harvest.
